newsitem.title: FINLAND: OUTOKUMPU ,ENDESA MAY BUILD COPPER SMELTER.
newsitem.headline: OUTOKUMPU ,ENDESA MAY BUILD COPPER SMELTER.

text.p: Finnish metals and mining group Outokumpu Oy said in a statement on Thursday it agreed with Chilean Endesa S.A. to study the feasibility of building an integrated copper smelter-refinery in Northern Chile.
"A preliminary estimate for the investment is $800 million," it said.

"According to pre-feasibility studies carried out by Outokumpu and Endesa, the market outlook would seem to favour the construction of a large greenfield smelter-refinery complex with an annual capacity of 300,000 to 400,000 tonnes of cathode copper," it said.
"Outokumpu and Endesa plan to own a majority interest between themselves but will invite other interested parties to join the project at a later stage," Outokumpu said.
The project would be in line with Outokumpu's strategy to strengthen its presence in the copper in the copper smelting and refining industry, it said.
"Subject to the results of the feasibility study and acceptable financing terms, the new plant is scheduled to start its operation during the next five years," it said.
The new plant was expected to use Outokumpu technology, it added. Chilean Endesa is listed in New York and Santiago and a spokeswoman said it is not related to the eponymous Spanish company.
